observations: Two solar panels leaning against a wall.
The panels have silver-colored aluminum frames.
The top surface is covered with dark photovoltaic cells.
The panels are shown in a warehouse or outdoor setting.
A watermark 'SOLAR ENERGY' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: The watermark 'SOLAR ENERGY' is visible across the center of the image, but the seller's name is not clearly legible on the panels themselves.

risks.risk: The panels may be used or refurbished rather than brand-new.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's specification sticker on the back of the panels.

risks.risk: The panels may have micro-cracks, hot spots, or other physical damage.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the cell surface and the back of the panels.

risks.risk: The panels may be non-functional or have a significantly degraded output.
risks.proof: A video showing a multimeter reading the open-circuit voltage (Voc) of the panels.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the specification sticker on the back of the panels.
Close-up photo of the cell surface to check for cracks or discoloration.
Video of a multimeter test showing the open-circuit voltage (Voc) of the panels.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
